title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Explore Brigham Young University's campus with these social activities and spaces that require no admission or purchase, from world-class art galleries to serene outdoor ponds.

cards.title: Gallery Browsing at the MOA
cards.subtitle: North Campus Drive
cards.notes: Walk through world-class exhibitions featuring religious art, American masters, and contemporary works. Admission is free for all visitors during standard museum hours.
cards.short_summary: A premier university art museum offering free access to diverse permanent and rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Museum is always free, as is entrance to all current exhibitions and most upcoming events.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit - BYU Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Monday, Thursday, Friday until 9 PM; Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday until 6 PM. Closed Sundays.

cards.entity_name: Monte L. Bean Life Science Museum
cards.title: Wildlife Exhibits at the Bean
cards.subtitle: North Canyon Road
cards.notes: Explore three floors of taxidermy, insect collections, and live animal shows. Grab a free scavenger hunt at the front desk to guide your group through the halls.
cards.short_summary: A natural history museum featuring extensive wildlife displays and educational live animal presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bean Museum first opened in 1978 and still offers free admission to all of its exhibits today.
cards.source_title: BYU offers free, on-campus activities, services - The Daily Universe
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Saturday. Live animal shows are scheduled throughout the day and are free to attend.

cards.title: Duck Watching at the Botany Pond
cards.subtitle: 800 North & 400 East
cards.notes: Relax by the water to see ducks and turtles. This quiet corner of campus features a boardwalk and grassy areas perfect for a low-key social afternoon.
cards.short_summary: A scenic campus pond known for its resident ducks, turtles, and peaceful atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The BYU Botany Pond is located on the south end of BYU campus... you'll find a grassy lawn, towering trees, and a beautiful pond.
cards.source_title: BYU Botany Pond - Utah's Adventure Family
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space. Best visited during daylight hours.

cards.title: Dinosaur Fossils at Paleontology
cards.subtitle: North Canyon Road
cards.notes: View one of the region's top dinosaur fossil collections. Watch researchers work in the visible prep lab as they clean and preserve ancient specimens.
cards.short_summary: A specialized museum showcasing a significant collection of Jurassic period fossils and a working lab.
cards.evidence_claim: One of the better dinosaur fossil collections in the region, with a working prep lab behind glass. Admission is free.
cards.source_title: 11 free things to do on BYU's campus - Provo FOMO
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 9 AM - 5 PM. Located across from the stadium.

cards.title: Global Artifacts at the MPC
cards.subtitle: North University Avenue
cards.notes: Discover artifacts from cultures around the world. This teaching museum offers free general admission to its rotating anthropological and archaeological exhibits.
cards.short_summary: BYU's anthropological museum featuring artifacts from diverse global cultures with free public entry.
cards.evidence_claim: General admission is free. The museum displays artifacts from different cultures every year.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit - Museum of Peoples and Cultures
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 9 AM - 5 PM. Extended hours on Tuesdays until 7 PM during the school year.

cards.title: Carillon Bell Concerts
cards.subtitle: Phillips Lane
cards.notes: Listen to the 52-bell carillon from the surrounding lawns. Live performances are often held during campus events and are free for the public to enjoy outdoors.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor musical performances featuring the university's iconic 52-bell carillon tower.
cards.evidence_claim: Bring lawn chairs, blankets, and picnics to the shady lawns surrounding the bell tower to enjoy a free evening concert.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor listening area is always accessible; check university calendars for live performance times.

cards.title: Social Study at the HBLL
cards.subtitle: Campus Drive
cards.notes: Utilize open group study tables or the 'Snack Zone' on Level 3 for collaborative work. These spaces are free for students to use without reservation.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering various free collaborative and individual study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Open Group Study Tables. Use these 'no shh' areas to collaborate with classmates in an open environment.
cards.source_title: Rooms & Spaces | Services | HBLL - BYU Library
cards.access_notes: Open late until 11:45 PM most nights. Closed Sundays.

cards.title: Board Game Checkouts
cards.subtitle: Ernest L. Wilkinson Student Center
cards.notes: Check out board games for free at the student center. It's a popular way to spend an evening with friends in the various lounge areas of 'the Wilk'.
cards.short_summary: A free recreational service providing board games for student use within the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: The WSC also has board games that can be checked out for free along with pool and ping pong table supplies.
cards.source_title: BYU offers free, on-campus activities, services - The Daily Universe
cards.access_notes: Available during WSC operating hours. Check out at the information desk or games center.

cards.title: Student Art at The Weight Room
cards.subtitle: West Campus Central Building
cards.notes: Visit this student-centered gallery to see rotating exhibitions from the Department of Art. It hosts approximately 50 exhibitions annually and is free to the public.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated campus gallery space showcasing contemporary student art projects and exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Weight Room consists of five adjoining spaces that host approximately fifty different exhibitions annually. Admission: Free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 9 AM - 5 PM. Located in WCCB 2470.

cards.title: Planetarium Watch Parties
cards.subtitle: Eyring Science Center
cards.notes: Join the BYU Astronomical Society for free documentary watch parties and discussions. These events are open to all majors and held in the planetarium.
cards.short_summary: Free weekly documentary screenings and celestial discussions hosted by the student astronomy club.
cards.evidence_claim: The BYU Astronomical Society hosts documentary watch parties every Thursday night... The shows are open to all members of the club and are free of charge.
cards.source_title: BYU astronomical society hosts weekly planetarium watch parties
cards.access_notes: Typically held Thursday nights at 6:30 PM during spring/summer terms; check club schedules for fall/winter.
